summary: Analysis only; no solver, no Lean. Three scope corrections to Lemma C: terminal satisfiability is not global k-colourability; w_i need not differ from alpha, so the terminal minimum is 3 colours, not 4; and level 5 is NOT useless - an explicit finite non-5-colourable unit-distance graph would replace a 62-page analytic argument by a finite certificate. MAIN RESULT, Lemma S (spare colour): if G is (k-1)-colourable and T is NR-k, then T is MONOCHROMATIC in every proper (k-1)-colouring. The proof turns on k being fresh, hence colliding with nothing; the monochromatic case is sharp, since one spare colour cannot make a monochromatic triple rainbow (checked at k=5,6). Corollary 1: if G is (k-1)-colourable and every pair is separable at level k-1, G has NO NR-k triple, so G_553 admits no NR-6 triple anywhere - closed there. Corollary 2, stronger and needing no separation: no (k-1)-colourable graph has u,v with three pairwise-adjacent witnesses each NR-k. At k=6 that rules out any 5-colourable carrier, so the composition needs an explicitly 6-chromatic finite UDG - the level-5 route's own target. Level 6 presupposes level 5; Heule 553 certifies only chi >= 5. Specification (S) for composing three NR gadgets given in full.

verified_results.statement: Correction: colouring the five terminals shows only terminal-level satisfiability, not that G is k-colourable. In Lemma C, Omega_k(G) nonempty is a global hypothesis, separate from any terminal colouring.

Correction: with c(u)=c(v)=alpha, w_i may also take alpha unless an explicit edge u w_i (or v w_i) forbids it. Terminal-level minimum is 3 colours (three pairwise-adjacent witnesses, one of which may be alpha); 4 only when u or v is adjacent to all three witnesses. The earlier claim of 4 is withdrawn.
verified_results.grade: self-correction; PROOF of the corrected count

verified_results.statement: Correction of scope: level 5 is valuable. An explicit exactly coordinated finite non-5-colourable unit-distance graph would give a short, finite, machine-checkable proof of chi(R^2) >= 6 in place of the 62-page analytic argument, which serves the simplification objective even though it does not decide 6 vs 7.
verified_results.grade: self-correction; the implication chain itself is PROOF (Lemma C + audited amplifier)

verified_results.statement: Lemma S (spare colour): if G is (k-1)-colourable and T = {a,b,c} is NR-k, then T is monochromatic in every proper (k-1)-colouring of G.
verified_results.grade: PROOF (three cases; the only ingredient is that colour k is fresh, so recolouring one vertex to it stays proper)

verified_results.statement: Sharpness of Lemma S: the monochromatic case genuinely survives, because a single spare colour cannot turn a monochromatic triple rainbow (two fresh colours would be needed). Enumerated over patterns (1,1,1),(1,1,2),(1,2,3) and all three recolourings, k=5 and k=6: only (1,1,1) fails to reach rainbow. So Lemma S is necessary, not sufficient, i.e. a filter.
verified_results.grade: EXACT pattern enumeration; no graph, no solver

verified_results.statement: Corollary 1: if G is (k-1)-colourable and every pair is separated by some proper (k-1)-colouring, then G has no NR-k triple.
verified_results.grade: PROOF (Lemma S gives monochromaticity; pair separation contradicts it)

verified_results.statement: Specialisation: G_553 is 5-colourable and (Sep_5) is verified by the 34-witness chase, so G_553 admits NO NR-6 triple anywhere. This closes condition (M4) of COMPOSITION.md on Heule 553, and with it the k=6 instance of the arity-3 route on that graph.
verified_results.grade: PROOF given G_553's 5-colourability and the supervisor-verified (Sep); those two inputs are inherited, not re-derived here

verified_results.statement: Corollary 2: in ANY (k-1)-colourable graph there do not exist u,v and pairwise-adjacent w_1,w_2,w_3 with each {u,v,w_i} NR-k. Proof: every (k-1)-colouring makes each T_i monochromatic, hence all five terminals share one colour, contradicting pairwise adjacency of the w_i. No pair separation is used.

Consequence at k=6: the three-witness composition cannot live in any 5-colourable graph, so realising it requires a finite unit-distance graph that is 6-colourable and not 5-colourable, i.e. exactly 6-chromatic. Since G_553 is 5-chromatic (certifying only chi >= 5) and the paper's chi >= 6 is analytic with no graph exhibited, the k=6 arity-3 route presupposes the level-5 target.
verified_results.grade: PROOF of the dependency; the non-existence of an explicit 6-chromatic finite UDG is cited from the project record, not re-verified

verified_results.statement: Level-5 route is live: Lemma S does not apply at k=5 on G_553 because G_553 is not 4-colourable, so NR-5 triples are not excluded. Such a triple feeds Lemma C at k=5, giving a forced-equal pair, and the audited amplifier then yields a finite non-5-colourable graph with coordinates in K(sqrt(4n^2 d^2 - 1)) and at most 2nV-2n+1 vertices.
verified_results.grade: PROOF of the chain; existence of an NR-5 triple is OPEN and not claimed

verified_results.statement: Monotonicity (MON): NR is preserved under adding vertices and edges, since every k-colouring of the extension restricts to one of the subgraph. So gluing gadgets cannot destroy an NR fact; what gluing can destroy is global colourability, which is the mirror image and is why (S6) is a separate obligation.

Specification (S) for composing three NR gadgets with common u,v and unit triangle w_1,w_2,w_3, in seven clauses: exact coordinates in a number field; the unit triangle; u,v distinct and non-adjacent; each {u,v,w_i} NR-k in its sub-gadget and transported by (MON); an accident audit covering coincidences, accidental cross-gadget and gadget-terminal unit edges, and accidental formation of a triangle; global Omega_k(G) nonempty as a separate obligation; and E(G) taken as the full induced unit-distance graph, not a selected subset.
verified_results.grade: specification, not an instance; satisfiability of (S) is the open problem

verified_results.statement: No new forcing is claimed. No NR-5 or NR-6 triple is asserted to exist; no gadget is exhibited.

conjectures: An NR-5 triple in G_553 is the single live seed in this line. If one exists, Lemma C at k=5 plus the amplifier gives an explicit 6-chromatic finite unit-distance graph - a shortening of the lower bound rather than a solution of 6 vs 7.
By Corollary 2 the level-6 composition needs an explicitly 6-chromatic graph, so it cannot be cheaper than the level-5 route; any future block should treat it as strictly downstream.
